bmql-safe.notes: Safe parameterized BMQL query with null and size guard. Use $variable placeholders to prevent SQL injection.

bmql-loop.notes: BMQL query with guarded loop iteration. Prevents null pointer errors on empty result sets.

sb-concat.notes: Use StringBuilder (sbappend/sbtostring) instead of string concatenation in loops to avoid O(n²) memory allocation.

null-guard.notes: Guard pattern for null or empty string variables. Combine isnull() with trim() == "" for comprehensive null/empty detection.

split-safe.notes: Always check sizeofarray() before accessing split() array indices to prevent out-of-bounds errors.

try-atoi.notes: Always guard atoi()/atof() with isnumber() to prevent runtime conversion errors on non-numeric input.
